speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Raj says he can teach you, what did you call it? I don't know, some Indian meditation crap.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I see. Well, I assume, since the rest of you have set the bar so low, you're saving the most impressive contribution for last. Go ahead, Howard. Dazzle me.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: My power is the ability to pretend like I give a damn about your piddly-ass problems.

speaker: penny
text: So, what do you say, Sheldon? Are we your X-Men?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: No. The X-Men were named for the X in Charles Xavier. Since I am Sheldon Cooper, you will be my C-Men.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Oh, that's not a good name.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Okay, Sheldon. I'm going to be leading you through a series of meditation exercises. These methods come from the ancient gurus of India and have helped me overcome my own fears.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: And yet, you can't speak to women.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: True, but thanks to meditation, I am able to stay in the same room with them without urinating.
